newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic filed Cablevision complaint.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic filed Cablevision complaint.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp on Friday said it was filing a complaint with the Federal Communications Commission against Cablevision Systems Corp and an affiliated company, seeking access to their sports programming.
Bell Atlantic said it was also seeking a damage award to compensate for its losses.

The company alleges that Cablevision and Rainbow have refused to provide its Video Services unit with program rights to SportsChannel New York, SportsChannel Philadelphia and the PRISM sports programming service in Philadelphia.
As a result, Bell Atlantic said it was unable to distribute the regional sports programming in the Dover Township, N.J., through its open video system.
In a separate statement, the Cablevision affiliate, Rainbow Programming Holdings Inc, said Bell Atlantic's assertions were "baseless" and the FCC complaint was "without merit".
Rainbow said it intended to file a complaint against Bell Atlantic with the FCC regarding a $345,000 refund that it alleges it is due from the company.
